title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of the National Intellectual Property Strategy
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Several Opinions on Implementing the National Intellectual Property Strategy

Fa Fa [2009] No. 16

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Supreme People's Court's Several Opinions on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the National Intellectual Property Strategy are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation in light of the actual work of adjudication.

March 23, 2009

Several Opinions on Issues Concerning the Implementation of the National Intellectual Property Strategy

The 17th National Congress of the Communist Party of China explicitly put forward the requirement of "implementing the intellectual property strategy." The State Council issued the Outline of the National Intellectual Property Strategy (hereinafter referred to as the "Outline") on June 5, 2008, deciding to implement the national intellectual property strategy. Implementing the national intellectual property strategy is a long-term and urgent important task before the people's courts nationwide. People's courts at all levels must take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the Important Thought of "Three Represents" as guidance, deeply study and practice the Scientific Outlook on Development, always adhere to the "Three Supremes" guiding ideology, closely focus on the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," comprehensively strengthen the construction of the judicial protection system for intellectual property, fully leverage the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property, and provide strong judicial guarantees for building an innovative country and building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. Now, in accordance with the requirements of the national intellectual property strategy and in light of the actual situation of the people's courts' judicial protection of intellectual property, the following opinions are formulated.

I. Fully Recognize the Great Significance of Implementing the National Intellectual Property Strategy, and Effectively Enhance the Sense of Responsibility and Mission of the People's Courts in Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property

1. Implementing the intellectual property strategy is a major strategic decision to enhance independent innovation capability, build an innovative country, promote sound and rapid development of the national economy, and achieve the goal of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. Improving independent innovation capability and building an innovative country is the core of the national development strategy and the key to enhancing comprehensive national strength. Implementing the intellectual property strategy is a major strategic deployment made by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council in the new era of reform and opening up, based on the need to enhance independent innovation capability and build an innovative country. It is a matter concerning the future of the country and the nation. The current international financial crisis, which is spreading to the real economy, further highlights the importance of strengthening intellectual property protection, enhancing independent innovation capability, and building an innovative country. People's courts at all levels must, from the perspective of deeply implementing the Scientific Outlook on Development, and from the angle of China's own economic, social, and cultural development needs, the rapid development of the knowledge economy, and the acceleration of economic globalization, deeply understand that the intellectual property strategy is an important national strategy for China to actively use the intellectual property system to promote economic development and social progress; they must deeply understand that implementing the intellectual property strategy is an urgent need for building an innovative country, a necessary path for transforming the economic development mode, and a key measure for enhancing the national core competitiveness, from the aspects of being conducive to enhancing China's independent innovation capability, perfecting China's socialist market economy system, enhancing the market competitiveness of Chinese enterprises and improving the national core competitiveness, and expanding opening up; they must deeply understand the guiding ideology and basic spirit of implementing the national intellectual property strategy from the four aspects of motivating creation, effective utilization, protection according to law, and scientific management.

2. Properly implementing the national intellectual property strategy is an important mission of the people's courts to serve the overall situation. Serving the overall situation of the Party and the state is an important starting point and foothold for the people's courts' judicial protection of intellectual property. People's courts at all levels must clearly recognize the situation and define their tasks, with a high sense of political responsibility and historical mission, effectively enhance the consciousness and determination to implement the national intellectual property strategy, firmly rely on the leadership of the Party committee, the supervision of the people's congress, the support of the government, and the concern of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference and all sectors of society, seize opportunities, face difficulties, take the initiative, forge ahead, strengthen organizational leadership, increase investment, and ensure the implementation of the relevant work requirements of the people's courts in the national intellectual property strategy and the smooth implementation of various strategic measures in a planned and step-by-step manner, so that the people's courts can play a more active role in the process of implementing the national intellectual property strategy.

II. Fully Leverage the Leading Role of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights, and Effectively Ensure the Construction of an Innovative Country

3. Vigorously strengthen the construction of the people's courts' judicial protection system for intellectual property, and effectively play the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights. In light of the new situation and new tasks and the actual situation of intellectual property protection in China, the Outline incorporates "strengthening the construction of the judicial protection system" and "leveraging the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights" into the focus of the national intellectual property strategy. This is a basic positioning of the functional role of China's judiciary in intellectual property protection, and also a high expectation and new requirement for China's judicial protection of intellectual property work from the overall and national development strategy perspective. To implement the national intellectual property strategy, the people's courts must enhance the consciousness and initiative of playing the leading role of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, take guaranteeing and promoting the construction of an innovative country as the basic goal, attach great importance to and comprehensively strengthen intellectual property adjudication work, fully leverage the functions of various intellectual property adjudications, effectively increase the intensity of judicial protection of intellectual property, continuously improve the overall effectiveness of the people's courts' judicial protection of intellectual property, and strive to create a judicial environment that encourages and guides innovation; they must vigorously solve prominent problems affecting and restricting scientific development, continuously improve the judicial level and judicial efficiency, promptly issue judicial interpretations and judicial policies, establish and improve relevant intellectual property litigation systems, and vigorously perfect the judicial protection system for intellectual property; they must strive to build a trial system and work mechanism conducive to scientific development and consistent with the characteristics of intellectual property cases, comprehensively optimize the allocation of trial resources for intellectual property, upgrade the overall quality of the intellectual property trial team, and significantly enhance the people's courts' capability of judicial protection of intellectual property.

4. Fully leverage the functions of various intellectual property adjudications, and comprehensively strengthen judicial protection of all types of intellectual property rights. Take case handling as the primary task, continuously improve the quality and efficiency of intellectual property adjudication, strive to ensure that each case can be adjudicated fairly and timely in accordance with the law and effectively enforced, enhance the credibility and authority of judicial protection of intellectual property, effectively reflect the final role of the court in resolving disputes, maximize the protection of the innovation rights and interests of the people, and achieve fairness and justice in the field of intellectual property. Fully utilize the three adjudicative functions of criminal, civil, and administrative, vigorously leverage the overall effectiveness of intellectual property adjudication, and provide comprehensive and effective judicial protection for various intellectual property rights. Severely punish all types of crimes of infringing intellectual property rights in accordance with the law, comprehensively apply various criminal sanctions, and fully leverage the function of criminal adjudication in punishing and preventing intellectual property crimes; properly regulate civil legal relationships involving various intellectual property rights, reasonably define the rights and obligations of the parties, actively adopt civil remedies, and fully leverage the main channel function of civil adjudication in resolving various intellectual property disputes; protect the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts in accordance with the law, supervise and support relevant competent administrative authorities in performing their respective intellectual property administrative enforcement and administrative management duties within their terms of reference, and fully leverage the function of administrative adjudication in supervising and supporting administrative protection of intellectual property.

5. Comprehensively apply judicial remedy measures for intellectual property, and continuously enhance the effectiveness of judicial protection of intellectual property. Determine the various legal liabilities that the parties should bear in accordance with the law, actively adopt various remedy measures, and provide comprehensive and effective protection for intellectual property. Provide material and spiritual, monetary and non-monetary comprehensive relief to the right holders through judgments of compensation for economic losses, orders to cease infringement, elimination of adverse effects, and apologies; provide actual and temporary judicial relief to the right holders through final judgments and pre-litigation or in-litigation provisional measures rulings; deprive the infringer of the ability to re-infringe and eliminate the risk of re-infringement through fines, confiscation of property, and civil sanctions. In particular, highlight the role of damages in sanctioning infringement and relieving rights, adhere to the principle of full compensation, increase the amount of compensation in accordance with the law, aggravate the liability for compensation for serious infringements such as malicious infringement, repeated infringement, and large-scale infringement, strive to ensure that the right holder obtains sufficient and full compensation, and effectively guarantee the realization of the legitimate rights and interests of the parties.

6. Promptly clarify the applicable standards for intellectual property laws, and effectively play the guiding role of judicial protection of intellectual property. Based on the legal application needs in judicial protection of intellectual property, seriously summarize the experience of trial practice, promptly issue judicial interpretations, unify judicial standards, and provide operational normative basis for ensuring the correct application of laws and effective protection of intellectual property. Conduct in-depth investigation and research, identify the combination points and focus points of judicial protection serving economic and social development, clarify judicial policies through various effective forms, strengthen judicial guidance, and actively guide economic, social, and cultural development. Accelerate the construction of a judicial case guidance system for intellectual property that conforms to China's national conditions, fully leverage the role of guiding cases in standardizing the exercise of discretion and unifying legal application standards, and reduce arbitrariness in the discretion process. Adjudicate and properly decide various complex, difficult, and new types of intellectual property disputes in accordance with the law, timely provide value judgments and behavioral guidance for enterprises and society, and regulate and promote the development of emerging industries. Strengthen the reasoning of intellectual property judgments, fully disclose judgment documents, achieve openness throughout the entire trial process, leverage the educational and guiding role of judicial judgments, prompt the parties to settle disputes, and guide non-parties to resolve similar disputes on their own.

7. Strive to strengthen the coordination and cooperation between the people's courts and other judicial organs and intellectual property administrative enforcement authorities, and promote the formation of overall synergy for intellectual property protection. Strengthen cooperation with the public security and procuratorial organs in the criminal judicial process for intellectual property, adjudicate and decide criminal cases of intellectual property in accordance with the law, and effectively increase the intensity of criminal protection. Strengthen the connection with the competent administrative departments such as industry and commerce, copyright, and patents in the administrative enforcement process of intellectual property, achieve complementary advantages and positive interactions between judicial protection and administrative protection. Strengthen communication and coordination with comprehensive departments such as intellectual property, foreign affairs, commerce, science and technology, information industry, journalism, and publicity in intellectual property protection work, and expand the influence of China's intellectual property protection.

III. Properly Adjudicate All Types of Intellectual Property Cases, and Effectively Strengthen Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property

8. Balance various important relationships, ensure the implementation of the various special tasks proposed in the Outline in the people's court system, and achieve comprehensive, coordinated, and sustainable development of intellectual property adjudication. First, handle the relationship between executing laws and serving the overall situation. While adhering to the supremacy of the Constitution and laws, performing statutory duties, following judicial rules, judicial channels, and judicial methods, and handling cases strictly in accordance with the law to achieve fair justice and maintain legal authority, it is also necessary to strengthen the overall situation awareness and macro-thinking, correctly handle the relationship between local interests and overall interests, strive to achieve the organic unity of the legal effect and social effect of handling cases, and ensure the correct political direction. Second, handle the relationship between protecting private rights and safeguarding the public interest. While strengthening the awareness of private rights protection and respecting the laws of private rights protection, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the parties in accordance with the law, and achieving the goal of the intellectual property system of motivating innovation through protecting private rights, it is also necessary to reasonably define the boundaries of intellectual property rights, comply with the mandatory norms set by the law to protect the public interest, ensure the balance between private rights and the public interest, and maintain public order. Third, handle the relationship between protection according to law and appropriate protection. Fully consider and grasp the development status of China's economy, society, science, technology, and culture, be good at using judicial policies, discretion, and legal application techniques to make judicial protection both legal and appropriate; it can stimulate technological innovation and economic development, and also facilitate the dissemination and utilization of knowledge; it can effectively protect innovation achievements and innovation rights and interests, and also promote enterprises to improve their independent innovation capability. Fourth, handle the relationship between protecting rights and preventing abuse. While strengthening the intensity of judicial protection of intellectual property, severely cracking down on serious infringements such as counterfeiting and piracy, substantially reducing the cost of rights protection, substantially increasing the cost of infringement, effectively curbing infringement, and effectively protecting the legitimate rights and interests of right holders and consumers, and maintaining the market order of fair competition, it is also necessary to prevent the abuse of intellectual property rights, examine and support defenses such as prior rights, prior use rights, prior art, estoppel, and fair use in accordance with the law, stop monopolistic behavior, accept and examine lawsuits for confirmation of non-infringement and counterclaims for damages caused by abusive litigation in accordance with the law, regulate the abuse of intellectual property rights and litigation procedures to suppress competitors, exclude and restrict competition, and hinder innovation, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of the public.

9. Strengthen judicial protection of patent rights, safeguard the rights and interests of technological innovation, and promote independent innovation. Proceeding from China's national conditions, guided by national strategic needs, protect patent rights in accordance with the law, determine a reasonable scope and intensity of protection based on China's stage of technological development and industrial intellectual property policy, balance the interests of right holders, users, and the public, and strengthen the guiding role of judicial policy on intellectual property in technological innovation activities. Increase the protection of key core technologies with independent intellectual property rights that have a significant breakthrough driving effect on economic growth, promote the development of high-tech industries and emerging industries, enhance China's independent innovation capability, and strengthen the national core competitiveness. Continuously improve the judgment standards for patent infringement, accurately determine the scope of patent protection, correctly identify patent infringement acts, and while protecting patent rights in accordance with the law, prevent the improper expansion of the patent protection scope, compression of innovation space, and damage to innovation capability and the public interest. Strictly interpret patent claims, fully respect the notice and demarcation function of claims, properly handle the relationship between literal infringement and infringement under the doctrine of equivalents, appropriately and strictly apply the conditions for infringement under the doctrine of equivalents, reasonably determine the scope of application of the doctrine of equivalents, and prevent excessive application of the doctrine of equivalents. Pay attention to the role of people's assessors, expert witnesses, expert consultation, and technical appraisal, and effectively resolve issues of technical fact determination through multiple approaches and channels.

10. Strengthen judicial protection of trademark rights, maintain trademark reputation, and promote the formation of independent brands. Through the trial of trademark cases, support and guide enterprises to implement trademark strategies, urge them to actively and standardly use their own trademarks in business operations, and promote the formation of independent brands and the development of brand economy. Severely sanction infringement acts such as trademark counterfeiting and malicious imitation, strictly apply infringement legal liabilities, effectively protect the interests of trademark owners and consumers, and maintain the market order of fair competition. Correctly grasp the legal attributes of trademark rights, reasonably define the scope of trademark rights based on the core function of trademarks to distinguish the source of goods or services, determine the intensity and scope of protection based on the degree of distinctiveness and fame of the trademark, and accurately identify the similarity of goods, similarity of trademarks, and misleading consequences in trademark infringement determination. Correctly grasp the legal positioning of judicial recognition and protection of well-known trademarks, adhere to judicial principles such as case-by-case recognition, passive recognition, and need-based recognition, prudently recognize well-known trademarks in accordance with the law, reasonably and appropriately determine the scope of cross-class protection for well-known trademarks, and strengthen the trial supervision and professional guidance of related cases. Properly handle the relationship between trademark protection and the development of specific industries, while focusing on protecting trademark rights, it is also conducive to promoting the upgrading and development of related industries. Adjudicate and timely handle cases involving geographical indications, Olympic symbols, World Expo symbols, and special symbols in accordance with the law.

11. Strengthen judicial protection of copyright, safeguard the legitimate rights of copyright owners, and enhance the cultural soft power of the nation. Severely sanction infringement acts such as piracy and plagiarism, increase compensation for infringement, and raise the awareness of copyright protection in the whole society. Reasonably define the relationship between copyright protection and fair use and statutory license in accordance with the law, balance the interests among creators, disseminators, and users, ensure the balance between private rights and the public interest, and protect the basic cultural rights and interests of the people. Strengthen the trial of copyright cases in fields such as news publishing, radio, film and television, literature and art, cultural entertainment, advertising design, arts and crafts, computer software, and information networks, promote the healthy and orderly development of copyright-related industries, advance cultural innovation, enhance the vitality of cultural development, and prosper the cultural market. Effectively respond to the challenges posed by new technologies such as the Internet to copyright protection, accurately grasp the standard of judicial protection of copyright in the network environment, properly handle the relationship between protecting copyright and ensuring information dissemination, while being conducive to the development and application of new network technologies and new business models and promoting information dissemination, it is also necessary to fully consider the characteristics of online infringement and the difficulties of rights protection, improve the evidence rules in the network environment, and effectively protect copyright. Increase the judicial protection of computer software, help enterprises explore markets, and promote the growth of related service outsourcing industries.

12. Strengthen judicial protection of trade secrets, protect enterprise rights and employees' freedom of employment, and ensure commercial information security and reasonable flow of talent. Sanction acts of stealing, illegally disclosing, and using others' trade secrets in accordance with the law, protect the trade secret rights of enterprises, and guide market entities to establish and improve trade secret management systems in accordance with the law. Properly handle the relationship between protecting trade secrets and free employment, and between non-competition obligations of secret-keepers and reasonable flow of talent, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees. Based on the characteristics of trade secret cases, reasonably allocate the burden of proof among the parties, and reasonably determine the confidentiality obligations of the parties and participants in the proceedings. Pay attention to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of the accused infringer regarding their own trade secrets, and prevent the plaintiff from abusing the right to sue to obtain others' trade secrets.

13. Strengthen judicial protection of plant variety rights, motivate agricultural scientific and technological innovation, and promote agricultural development. Strengthen the protection of agricultural intellectual property, protect plant variety rights and breeding technology in accordance with the law, increase the protection of major agricultural scientific and technological achievements and plant varieties with independent intellectual property rights, reasonably adjust the interests among resource providers, breeders, producers, and operators, motivate agricultural scientific and technological innovation, promote the transformation of modern agricultural management methods, promote agricultural development, protect the interests of farmers, maintain rural stability, and ensure the construction of a new socialist countryside. Accurately grasp the judgment standard for infringement of plant varieties, determine the scope of protection of variety rights based on the trait characteristics carried by the reproductive material, and take the production, sale, or repeated use of the reproductive material of the authorized variety as the act of infringement. Determine civil liability in accordance with the law, ensure the realization of the rights and interests of the right holder, pay attention to the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of farmers, and reasonably balance the interests between the right holder and the public through rights limitations such as breeder exemption and farmer exemption. Adhere to the principle of balancing the need to promptly stop infringement and prevent further dissemination of infringing goods while avoiding waste of resources, and prudently apply the civil liability of destroying infringing goods. Given the seasonal characteristics of seed production and sales, pay attention to using evidence preservation measures to promptly fix relevant evidence.

14. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property in specific fields, effectively protect special resources, and safeguard China's characteristic advantages. In accordance with existing legal rules and legislative spirit, actively protect genetic resources, traditional knowledge, folk literature and art, and all other intangible cultural heritage; based on history and reality, fairly and reasonably coordinate and balance the interests of all parties involved in the processes of exploration, collation, inheritance, protection, development, and utilization; protect the legitimate rights and interests of providers and holders regarding informed consent and benefit-sharing, and reasonably utilize relevant information. Strengthen the protection of traditional medicine and traditional crafts, promote the development of traditional knowledge and folk literature and art, facilitate the transformation of traditional resources into actual productive forces and market competitiveness, and promote advantages of national industries and regional specialized economic advantages. Legally protect the exclusive rights to layout designs of integrated circuits, provide timely judicial relief, and promote the development of the integrated circuit industry.

15. Legally prevent unfair competition, regulate market competition order, and promote the formation of a unified, open, competitive, and orderly modern market system. Properly adjudicate cases of unfair competition such as counterfeiting the unique names, packaging, or decoration of well-known goods, false advertising, and commercial defamation; actively accept new types of intellectual property cases involving enterprise names (trade names), trade dress, and computer network domain names; stop all dishonest counterfeiting and free-riding behaviors, avoid market confusion and public misleading, effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of rights holders and consumers, ensure honest and orderly competition, and promote the construction of a social credit system. Legally and actively accept civil disputes involving conflicts between registered trademarks, enterprise names, and prior rights, and make proper adjudication in accordance with principles such as following good faith, maintaining fair competition, and protecting prior rights. Accurately grasp the legislative spirit and applicable conditions of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law; while keeping pace with the times, apply the general provisions of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law to regulate and adjust new competitive behaviors that appear in the market; and strictly comply with the law: for competitive behaviors not specifically regulated by law, only when they can be found to violate the general provisions of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law based on recognized commercial standards and common understanding may they be deemed acts of unfair competition, to prevent hindering free and fair competition by improperly expanding the scope of unfair competition behaviors. For competitive fields where there is neither trade secrets nor statutory or agreed non-competition restrictions, it cannot be simply considered as constituting unfair competition by applying the general provisions of the Anti-Unfair Competition Law on the grounds of using or damaging specific competitive advantages.

16. Actively carry out antitrust trials, protect fair market competition, and safeguard consumer interests and the public interest. In accordance with the acceptance conditions stipulated in the Civil Procedure Law and the Anti-Monopoly Law, legally accept civil lawsuits filed by parties due to monopolistic acts. Earnestly perform trial duties, properly handle the relationship between competition policy and industrial policy, properly adjudicate monopoly cases involving abuse of intellectual property rights and other types of monopoly cases, stop monopolistic acts, encourage fair competition, improve the quality of introduced foreign investment, promote economic structural adjustment, and maintain the healthy and orderly operation of the national economy. Strengthen research and investigation work in antitrust trials, carefully summarize trial experience, and promptly clarify judicial principles, adjudication standards, and operating procedures.

17. Properly handle intellectual property contract disputes, maintain transaction security, and promote the creation and application of intellectual achievements. Respect the autonomy of the parties, maintain the seriousness and validity of contracts, strictly apply conditions for contract rescission, and legally punish breach of contract. Legally and reasonably grasp the statute of limitations for ownership disputes, accurately define service achievements and non-service achievements, which should both stimulate the innovation enthusiasm of R&D creators and promote the transformation and implementation of achievements. In the spirit of minimizing transaction risks and reducing transaction costs, legally define the legal relationships, interest distribution, and liability allocation formed in intellectual property commission or cooperative creation, transfer, licensing, pledge, and other links, promote the intellectual propertyization, commercialization, industrialization, and marketization of independent innovation achievements. Actively accept franchise contract disputes, and properly handle intellectual property agency contract disputes.

18. Carefully review applications for pre-litigation interim measures in intellectual property cases, issue rulings in a timely and prudent manner, and effectively stop infringement. Give full play to the timely relief function of pre-litigation interim measures, ensure that rulings are made within the statutory time limit and executed immediately. For trademark and copyright infringement cases, especially obvious infringement and intentional infringement such as counterfeiting and piracy, pay attention to actively adopting pre-litigation orders to stop infringement. Appropriately tighten the criteria for determining the possibility of infringement, in principle reaching the level of basic certainty; in patent cases, especially invention and utility model patent cases, carefully decide to adopt pre-litigation orders to stop infringement. For applications for interim measures submitted by parties at the time of filing or during litigation, promptly review and issue rulings and execute them in a timely manner. For applications for evidence preservation, focus on considering the risk of evidence and the applicant's ability to collect evidence, and make timely rulings.

19. Strengthen judicial review of intellectual property authorization and confirmation acts, legally review authorization conditions, and unify and improve authorization review standards. Conduct comprehensive legality review of intellectual property authorization and confirmation administrative acts such as patents and trademarks in terms of fact determination and legal application; while giving appropriate respect to administrative authorities for their evaluation of professional and technical facts, independently review and judge the relevant substantive authorization conditions, and earnestly and comprehensively fulfill the basic duty of judicial review according to law. Strengthen work coordination and business exchange with administrative authorities, promote the unification and improvement of trial and review standards, and improve the law enforcement level of relevant cases. Strive to improve trial efficiency, promptly confirm the validity of rights according to law, and ensure the timeliness of rights maintenance and interest realization.

20. Strengthen administrative judicial protection of intellectual property, legally supervise administrative acts, and support administration according to law. Legally adjudicate various types of intellectual property administrative cases; in legality review, both protect the legitimate rights and interests of administrative counterparts in intellectual property matters and maintain the administrative management order of intellectual property, legally support administrative authorities in sanctioning infringements, and promote administrative protection of intellectual property. For administrative authorities applying for compulsory enforcement of administrative decisions, if upon review the conditions for enforcement are met, promptly issue a ruling and carry out compulsory enforcement.

21. Increase the intensity of criminal judicial protection of intellectual property, legally severely punish crimes of infringing intellectual property rights, and fully reflect the functions of punishment and deterrence. Legally accept intellectual property criminal cases and promptly make judgments, effectively increase the crackdown on crimes of counterfeiting registered trademarks and copyright infringement; while legally applying principal punishments, increase the application and enforcement of fines, and pay attention to adopting measures such as recovering illegal gains, confiscating criminal tools, and destroying infringing products to economically strip the criminal of the ability and conditions for re-offending. Cooperate with relevant departments to carry out special actions for intellectual property protection in a planned and focused manner against repeated infringement, group infringement, and large-scale counterfeiting and piracy, to curb counterfeiting and piracy phenomena. Unify and standardize the conditions and standards for applying penalties in intellectual property infringement criminal cases, accurately grasp the criminal policy of combining leniency and severity. Legally adjudicate criminal private prosecution cases of intellectual property infringement, effectively protect the right of victims to file criminal private prosecutions.

22. Strengthen supervision of intellectual property trials, protect the parties' right to petition, and maintain judicial fairness in intellectual property. While fully maintaining the res judicata of correct valid judgments, ensure that cases meeting statutory conditions enter retrial in a timely manner, ensuring fair justice and maintaining legal uniformity. Unify the standards for ordering retrial; take the effective judgment being actually erroneous as the standard for the superior court or the court itself to initiate retrial ex officio; take the existence of statutory grounds for retrial as the standard for ordering retrial upon the party's application. Through timely and standardized hearing procedures and patient and meticulous review and persuasion work, try to make the parties accept the judgment and drop their complaints, and reduce the rate of multiple petitions as much as possible. Strive to improve the quality and efficiency of review; if the sufficiency of grounds for retrial can be determined based on the petition, defense opinion, etc., a ruling may be made directly.

23. Increase the enforcement intensity of intellectual property cases, ensure the timely realization of adjudicated rights and interests, and establish the authority of judicial protection. Improve the compulsory enforcement mechanism for intellectual property cases, fully utilize the enforcement work linkage deterrence mechanism, improve measures such as escalated enforcement, designated enforcement, and entrusted enforcement, ensure the effective enforcement of intellectual property cases, and strengthen the timely enforcement of pre-litigation interim measures rulings. If the person subject to enforcement refuses to comply with the effective judgment content to stop infringement and continues the original infringing acts, in addition to supporting the rights holder in pursuing civil liability according to law, actively coordinate with public security and procuratorial authorities to pursue criminal liability for the crime of refusing to enforce a judgment or ruling.

24. Legally carry out foreign-related intellectual property judicial protection, ensure opening up, and promote international economic and trade cooperation. Properly handle the relationship between domestic interests and foreign interests, the relationship between foreign relations and specific case trials, and the interest relationship between domestic parties and foreign parties; always adhere to the principles of fair trial according to law and equal protection, maintain and enhance the good international image of China's judiciary, and optimize the external environment for economic development. Coordinate both domestic and international situations, properly handle major trade-related intellectual property disputes, while ensuring compliance with relevant international conventions and international practices, and always safeguard national interests and economic security. Pay attention to identifying weak links and management loopholes in intellectual property work from individual cases, and put forward improvement suggestions for administrative management through judicial suggestions and judgment reasoning, provide behavioral warnings for industries and sectors, improve the ability of enterprises to deal with intellectual property disputes, and extend the effect of intellectual property judicial protection.

IV. Improve the Intellectual Property Trial System and Working Mechanism, Optimize the Allocation of Trial Resources

25. Actively explore trial organization models suitable for the characteristics of intellectual property. In accordance with the requirements of the Outline, study the establishment of specialized intellectual property trial divisions that uniformly accept civil, administrative, and criminal intellectual property cases; as soon as possible unify the trial division of patent and trademark and other intellectual property authorization and confirmation cases; optimize the allocation of intellectual property trial resources, and achieve unified and efficient intellectual property justice. Carefully summarize the pilot work carried out by some local courts in recent years where one trial division uniformly accepts civil, administrative, and criminal intellectual property cases, and the exploration work of expanding the composition of the collegial panel or having intellectual property civil judges participate in the trial of intellectual property criminal and administrative cases; conduct in-depth investigation and research, seriously solve the problems arising in the pilot and exploration work, strengthen unified coordination and work guidance, and actively and steadily promote it.

26. Explore the establishment of an intellectual property appellate court. In accordance with the requirements of the Outline, strengthen communication, coordination, and cooperation with relevant departments; based on the requirements for improving the appeal mechanism for intellectual property cases, deeply study the feasibility and necessity of establishing an intellectual property appellate court; actively explore relevant reform paths and models; strive to achieve effective connection between the intellectual property confirmation procedure and the infringement litigation procedure; simplify judicial relief procedures; improve judgment efficiency; and ensure judicial uniformity.

27. Promote the reform of patent and trademark authorization and confirmation procedures. Actively cooperate with relevant state departments, with the goal of simplifying relief procedures, study the issue of transforming patent invalidation hearing and trademark review institutions into quasi-judicial bodies, and actively promote the revision of relevant legal provisions.

28. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism for intellectual property. Adhere to the principle of "mediation first, combination of mediation and adjudication" and the requirement of "resolving disputes and closing cases"; increase mediation efforts in intellectual property cases, and integrate mediation throughout the entire trial process. Attach great importance to mediation in pre-litigation interim measures cases and criminal private prosecution cases, and coordination in intellectual property administrative cases; strengthen the connection between trial work and people's mediation, administrative mediation, arbitration, and other dispute resolution methods; actively support mediation and arbitration institutions and intellectual property assistance centers in playing their role in handling intellectual property disputes; pay attention to the role of industry associations, professional departments, and professionals in communication, negotiation, and participation in mediation; expand the scope of cases inviting assistance for mediation; and strive to increase the rate of litigation mediation and withdrawal upon settlement.

29. Strengthen the publicity of intellectual property judicial protection. Vigorously publicize intellectual property judicial protection in various forms, raise the awareness of intellectual property in the whole society, and promote the construction of intellectual property culture. In conjunction with the press release system of the people's courts, timely release important news and typical cases in intellectual property trials, and strive to achieve the normalization of "April 26" World Intellectual Property Day judicial protection publicity. Adhere to the principle of open and transparent trial, and in strict accordance with relevant regulations and requirements, promptly upload effective intellectual property judgment documents to the Internet for public access. Regularly select influential cases, and invite representatives such as deputies to the National People's Congress, members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, experts and scholars, representatives of industry associations and relevant departments, representatives of foreign governments and international organizations' offices in China, and the general public to observe court hearings, enhance judicial openness, accept public supervision, and expand social influence.

30. Expand foreign exchanges and cooperation in intellectual property justice. Establish and improve the external information exchange and communication mechanism for intellectual property judicial protection; actively participate in international and regional intellectual property exchanges and cooperation; expand the depth of exchanges; increase publicity efforts; deepen the comprehensive and objective understanding of China's intellectual property judicial protection system and protection status by other countries. While carrying out intellectual property judicial protection based on China's national conditions and development needs, learn from and absorb beneficial foreign judicial experience in a targeted manner.

V. Strengthen the Work of Judicial Interpretation of Intellectual Property, Improve the Intellectual Property Litigation System

31. Timely formulate judicial interpretations of intellectual property. In accordance with the requirements of the Outline, enhance the pertinence and timeliness of judicial interpretations; in response to relatively common and prominent issues of legal application in trial practice, timely formulate judicial interpretations; clarify judicial principles and policies; unify judicial standards; standardize and refine the exercise of discretionary power; and improve the intellectual property litigation system. Strengthen the scientificity and effectiveness of judicial interpretations; conduct in-depth investigation and research; extensively listen to and solicit opinions from all sides; pay attention to the participation of academic groups, research institutions, and intermediary organizations; jointly provide intellectual support for improving the intellectual property judicial protection system. Recently issue a judicial interpretation on the judicial protection of well-known trademarks; as soon as possible issue judicial interpretations on judgment standards for patent infringement and antitrust civil litigation procedures.

32. Establish and improve relevant intellectual property litigation systems. In accordance with the requirements of the Outline, coordinate and cooperate with relevant departments; in response to the strong professionalism of intellectual property cases, establish and improve litigation systems such as judicial appraisal, expert witnesses, and technical investigation; encourage courts with conditions to actively explore effective methods and specific practices of technical investigation in the trial of technical cases such as patents. Improve the pre-litigation interim measures system for intellectual property; timely initiate the drafting of relevant judicial interpretations. Cooperate with relevant departments to clarify the qualification of intellectual property agents in litigation; promote relevant departments to study the establishment of relevant lawyer agency systems.

33. Adjust and improve the jurisdiction system for intellectual property cases. In accordance with the principle of facilitating court trial and party litigation while fully meeting the new demands of technological innovation and economic and social development for intellectual property trials, plan the intellectual property trial jurisdiction system comprehensively. Continue to adhere to the designated jurisdiction system for patent, new plant variety, and integrated circuit layout design cases; strictly control the number of intermediate people's courts with new patent case jurisdiction; appropriately concentrate jurisdiction over monopoly cases and special types of intellectual property cases involving well-known trademark recognition; appropriately increase the number of basic-level courts accepting general intellectual property cases such as copyright, trademark, unfair competition, and intellectual property contracts; with the designation of the superior people's court according to law, basic-level courts with jurisdiction over general intellectual property cases may cross-regional jurisdiction over general intellectual property cases within the jurisdiction of the same superior people's court.

VI. Strengthen the Construction of Intellectual Property Trial Team, Improve the Capability of Intellectual Property Judicial Protection

34. Further improve intellectual property trial institutions. People's courts at all levels should, based on the objective needs of the intellectual property trial duties and tasks they bear, and adhering to the principle of being realistic and taking both the present and the long-term into account, strengthen the institutional setup, staffing, and internal institution configuration of intellectual property trial divisions. Establish intellectual property trial divisions in intermediate courts and basic-level courts with case jurisdiction; for intermediate people's courts that temporarily lack the conditions for setting up an independent division, they should also establish or designate a collegial panel specifically responsible for hearing intellectual property cases.

35. Vigorously expand the intellectual property trial team. Adopt effective measures to adjust and strengthen the team of intellectual property judges, improve their quality, and strengthen trial and enforcement capabilities. Pay attention to selecting and cultivating intellectual property judges from personnel who are proficient in law, have a good foundation in foreign languages, have a background in science and engineering, and have certain trial experience, effectively alleviating the contradiction between the continuous growth of cases and the relative shortage of professional trial forces. Maintain the basic stability of the intellectual property judge team, improve the professional structure of intellectual property trial talents, and for intellectual property cases with strong professional and technical characteristics, try to have a relatively fixed collegial panel and professional judges handle them, focusing on cultivating a group of professional and expert intellectual property judges with high social recognition. Fully consider the laws of intellectual property trials and the cultivation of intellectual property judges, and adopt scientific and reasonable performance evaluation indicators in workload, business assessment, and other aspects. Actively carry out personnel and business exchanges with intellectual property professional departments such as the Patent Reexamination Board; encourage various forms of business and talent exchanges between courts in the eastern, central, and western regions. Increase training in intellectual property trial skills and professional knowledge; the Supreme People's Court and higher people's courts at all levels should formulate long-term training plans, update training outlines in a timely manner, ensure training time and quality, and focus on increasing training for intellectual property trial personnel in intermediate and basic-level courts and courts in the central and western regions.

36. Attach great importance to ideological and political construction and clean government construction of the intellectual property judge team. Strengthen the political discipline and work responsibility of intellectual property trial personnel, further strengthen education on the socialist concept of rule of law, so that all trial personnel firmly establish the guiding ideology of "Three Supremes" (party cause supremacy, people's interests supremacy, constitutional and legal supremacy), and truly achieve serving the people, pragmatism, and integrity. Strictly implement the systems and requirements for anti-corruption and promoting integrity, seriously implement the provisions of the "Five Prohibitions", every trial personnel must remain vigilant at all times, leaders at all levels must earnestly take responsibility, strengthen supervision and inspection of key links, standardize judicial behavior, severely punish violations, and ensure the fairness and integrity of intellectual property justice. Actively explore and vigorously publicize good experiences, good practices, good people, and good deeds in intellectual property judicial protection work, and establish a good image of the people's courts and intellectual property judges.
